## Description

Renovate proposes this dependency update under the family preset. The table below lists each package and its version change, and the release notes follow.

## Pre-Merge Verification Checklist

The bot ticks nothing; CI runs the repository's required gate on this pull request; items no check decides (3D tests among them) still need a reviewer's look.

- [ ] Local verification passed: `make verify-all`
- [ ] No new HISS / NASA Power-of-10 infractions (all new/modified functions
  $\le 60$ LOC)
- [ ] 3D Tests included (Positive, Negative, Boundary) for public APIs
- [ ] Agent contexts in sync: `standardsctl compile-context --verify`
- [ ] Commit messages adhere to Conventional Commits format

customManagers.description: The licence tool image: release in the comment above, digest in the line.
The actionlint release and checksum in the CI and workflow-check workflows.
matchStrings:
ACTIONLINT_VERSION: "(?<currentValue>v[^"]+)"
  # SHA-256 of actionlint_\S+_linux_amd64\.tar\.gz, from the release's checksum file\.
  ACTIONLINT_SHA256: "(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{64})"
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
ACTIONLINT_VERSION: "{{{newValue}}}"
  # SHA-256 of actionlint_{{{replace '^v' '' newValue}}}_linux_amd64.tar.gz, from the release's checksum file.
  ACTIONLINT_SHA256: "{{{newDigest}}}"

customManagers.description: The actionlint release in the Makefile.

matchStrings:
GITLEAKS_VERSION: "(?<currentValue>v[^"]+)"
  # SHA-256 of gitleaks_\S+_linux_x64\.tar\.gz, from the release's checksum file\.
  GITLEAKS_SHA256: "(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{64})"
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
GITLEAKS_VERSION: "{{{newValue}}}"
  # SHA-256 of gitleaks_{{{replace '^v' '' newValue}}}_linux_x64.tar.gz, from the release's checksum file.
  GITLEAKS_SHA256: "{{{newDigest}}}"
